#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modPow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    if (k >= n) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<long long> fac(n + 1);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        fac[i + 1] = (i + 1) * fac[i] % MOD;
    }
    
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fac[n] << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    int c = n - (int)k;
    vector<long long> invfac(n + 1);
    invfac[n] = modPow(fac[n], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = n; i >= 1; --i) {
        invfac[i - 1] = invfac[i] * i % MOD;
    }
    
    long long ans = fac[n] * invfac[c] % MOD * invfac[n - c] % MOD;
    
    long long tem = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
        long long comb = fac[c] * invfac[i] % MOD * invfac[c - i] % MOD;
        long long pow_val = modPow(c - i, n);
        long long tem1 = comb * pow_val % MOD;
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            tem = (tem + tem1) % MOD;
        } else {
            tem = (tem - tem1 + MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    ans = ans * tem % MOD * 2 % MOD;
    cout << ans << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
